scope: ATP player match aces, Hard and Clay only
rho_fit_method: Pearson correlation of paired standardised ace-count residuals

input_quality_gate.coverage_gap_activity_source: player-props-activity.csv including main, qualifying and Challenger matches

notes: v3 ATP ace projections stay frozen as the marginal mean input
thin L12M samples with substantial L24M/career evidence remain visible as stale-form research estimates
active players whose recent lower-level performance is absent from the main-tour baseline are labelled coverage-gap estimates, not stale
untouched 2026 historical-tier calibration is weaker than recent-ready calibration and cannot create automatic bets
WTA, Grass and double faults are excluded
BetMGM prices must be three-way de-vigged before value is assessed
